shots.content: Inside a kitchen, a long rectangular island stands between the refrigerator wall and the sink area, with stools arranged along its sides. A woman in an orange shirt on the sink-side guest stool proposes a stew recipe for dinner, with a man in a white shirt on the refrigerator-side guest stool and a woman in a blue shirt on the sink-end stool.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the refrigerator end, looking lengthwise along the kitchen island toward the sink area, with both guest-side stools and the sink-end stool in frame.

shots.content: The man in the white shirt leaves the refrigerator-side guest stool and exits the venue. The woman in the orange shirt asks about preparing the ingredients.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the cook side, centered on the two adjacent guest-side stools.

shots.content: The woman in the orange shirt reviews the stew recipe.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot from the sink end, looking lengthwise along the kitchen island toward the refrigerator wall, with both guest-side stools and the sink-end stool in frame.
